reason: We already pay an AMC to our ERP vendor and years of fee and student records sit in it. I'm not moving all of that to a new name, and the trust chairman won't sign off Rs 30,000-60,000 plus GST on top of what we already pay.
objection: Moving the data. If fee history or receipts go wrong in the middle of a session, parents get angry and I get blamed. I also can't see who these people are or whether they'll still be around in three years.
would_change_my_mind: If our current vendor raised the AMC a lot or kept failing us, and Capabble moved our old fee and student data for us for free, with another school nearby that already runs on it.
